item.title: Real, Surreal, and Photoreal
item.description: For a limited time, view paintings, works on paper, and even tapestries made by such talents as John Currin, Salvador Dalí, Carole Feuerman, William Glackens, Alex Katz, Fairﬁeld Porter, Man Ray, and John Sloan.

item.title: Gavin Glakas on Preparing for an Art Show
item.description: Principle Gallery is presenting "Proximate," a contemporary realism show featuring works by Gavin Glakas and Steven S. Walker. Here, Glakas takes us behind the scenes of what it's like to prepare for such a show with an ambitious goal of creating 12 new paintings on a time budget.

item.title: Featured Artwork: Melinda Whitmore
item.description: Melinda Whitmore: Melinda depicts the fullness of ordinary human life—its triumphs and trials—with honesty and candor. She is drawn to the vulnerability and psychology of the figure as much as to its physical form. Through paint and clay, she captures everyday gestures, love, and quiet humanity, moving beyond portraiture to reveal mood and spirit. Her […]

item.title: Gainsborough: The Fashion of Portraiture
item.description: Displaying more than two dozen paintings, the show will explore the richly interwoven relationship between Thomas Gainsborough’s portraits and fashion in the eighteenth century.

item.title: Jason Bard Yarmosky: Time Has Many Faces
item.description: Jason Bard Yarmosky’s work centers on themes of aging, time, and memory. He mixes traditional 17th- and 18th-century painting techniques with contemporary imagery, incorporating dreamlike elements, theatrical costume, and staged interiors that heighten a sense of intimacy.
